name: Declared execution branches (--branch / --no-create)
goal: Implement ADR-056: accept --branch <name> on mission approve, expedition commit and expedition start; record the binding in the entity record and as a ledger event (MISSION_BRANCH_BOUND / EXPEDITION_BRANCH_BOUND payload {entityId, branch, declared, created, baseCommit, declaredBy}); resolve execution branches binding-first (binding -> taxonomy candidates -> trunk); validate declared names (git check-ref-format, local or origin), refuse a branch bound to another live entity (DECLARED_BRANCH_IN_USE) and a missing branch with --no-create (DECLARED_BRANCH_MISSING); emit the recorded BRANCH_POLICY_OVERRIDDEN warning for non-canonical declarations; add the config-level declaredPatterns (warning-softening only).
